record.title: The Corbitt House Commission
record.player_safe_summary: Mr. Knott offers a daily fee for investigating the tenants' disappearance and the strange disturbances in the house, then asks for a written report.
record.brief: Keeper-only: Knott pays $20/day plus keys and address, and wants a report that lets him rent or sell the inherited house. He knows only rumor and the Macario tragedy — nothing of Corbitt's undead nature — and will not believe Mythos explanations without hard proof. He pressures the investigators if research exceeds a day. The report's content is the KP's call: a whitewash he can accept, or hard proof that forces him to face the truth. Finding Corbitt's remains in the basement is the decisive evidence any credible report needs.

completion.narrative: The investigators deliver a report Knott accepts (a clean bill for the house, or hard proof he cannot dodge); the KP semantically confirms the commission is discharged.

failure.narrative: Knott withdraws the commission or hires someone cheaper, or the investigation is abandoned with nothing to show for it.
